title: Tanto... como: introduce dos elementos que comparten una misma cualidad o acción, dándoles igual peso

sections.content: Tanto... como (both... and) links two subjects, objects, or phrases that share an action or quality equally -- neither one is presented as more important than the other. Don't confuse it with tan... como (as... as), which compares degree between two things instead.

items.spanish: Tanto los gobiernos como la sociedad civil de varios países enfrentaron la misma pregunta difícil.
items.english: Both governments and civil society in several countries faced the same difficult question.

items.spanish: El libro fue leído tanto por historiadores como por el público general en los años siguientes.
items.english: The book was read by both historians and the general public in the years that followed.

items.spanish: Tanto el informe argentino como el brasileño llegaron de forma independiente a la misma fórmula.
items.english: Both the Argentine and the Brazilian report arrived independently at the same formula.

items.spanish: Tanto "Nunca Más" como "Brasil: Nunca Mais" dejaron claro que la memoria histórica no dependería de una sola institución.
items.english: Both "Nunca Más" and "Brasil: Nunca Mais" made clear that historical memory would not depend on a single institution.

sections.content: The two items joined by tanto... como can be nouns, prepositional phrases, or clauses, but keep them grammatically parallel. When the subject is tanto X como Y, the verb usually goes plural, since it's treated as two subjects acting together.
